context_requirements: Functional autocrine/paracrine endothelin signaling driven by EDN1/EDN2/EDN3 expression
Expression of EDNRA and/or EDNRB on the target cells
A transcriptional program dependent on endothelin receptor activity (e.g., survival, inflammatory, or contractile gene networks)
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of endothelin-signaling gene sets among differentially expressed genes after treatment
Changes in EDN1, EDNRA, or EDNRB mRNA levels that track with drug treatment

evidence.supports: Dual endothelin receptor antagonism modulates tumor cell survival pathways in glioblastoma models
Macitentan inhibits ETR phosphorylation and suppresses pAkt/pMAPK survival signaling in ovarian cancer models
Long-term endothelin receptor blockade normalizes altered cardiac gene expression in heart failure
Bosentan reduces inflammatory gene expression and joint inflammation in monoarthritic mice
